verdict.rationale: Heap's own Sense Chat feature is a chat-based way to get analytics insights without a learning curve, which implies a natural-language interface. The only evidence is a single marketing line, so it is unclear which commands are supported or whether it can operate the product beyond answering analytics questions. The llms.txt probe only shows documentation formatted for LLMs and is not credited. missing for 10: explicit documentation that Sense Chat accepts natural-language queries or commands, scope of the actions it can perform (building charts, defining events, configuring the product), detailed first-party docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Sense Chat makes it easy for anyone to get started with analytics, no matter their experience. Skip the learning curve and lengthy onboarding—and go straight to insights.
